title: Several imbue items on ONE ability: does the game allow / stack them?
heroes: all hero-mapped builds (47 of 71 assign >=2 imbue items to one ability slot; 10 builds with unmapped heroes not counted)
items: Compress Cooldown, Duration Extender, Mystic Expansion, Frostbite Charm (modifier_value type); Surge of Power, Mercurial Magnum, Quicksilver Reload, Mystic Reverb, Ballistic Enchantment (active type); Echo Shard, Omnicharge Signet (active_non_ult)
mechanism: abilities.vdata gives each imbue item a CITADEL_TARGET_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IMBUE_* behaviour (ACTIVE / ACTIVE_NON_ULT / MODIFIER_VALUE); I found no per-ability imbue-capacity field in abilities.vdata or heroes.vdata (grep of every *mbue* key). Whether a second imbue replaces, is refused, or stacks is therefore not in the data. Tier of the premise: game-data FACT (types, absence of capacity field); outcome UNRESOLVED.
why: Largest single exposure in the build set: data.js assigns 2-5 imbue items to the same ability in 47 builds (e.g. dynamo_damage 5 on ability 1, mina 5, ratking_grenade 5). Earlier note (sandbox/GAPS.md [U]) counted 20; recount from data.js is 47+.
decision: If one imbue per ability: every such build has 1-4 dead item slots (2-5 items of 1.6k-6.4k+ each) and its imbue allocation must be re-split across abilities or dropped. If they stack: the model must add them (and Echo Shard + Compress Cooldown cooldown arithmetic).
test: setup Haze Haze
souls 30000
arms: P0 no imbue | A Compress Cooldown only | B Compress Cooldown then Surge of Power | C Surge of Power then Compress Cooldown | D Compress+Frostbite Charm
per arm: hardreset; souls 30000; give <items>; imbueown <item> Signature2 (each); basemods; cds; cast 2 0.6; mods; cds
readbacks: ability-2 cooldown (cds), imbue op result/refusal text, mods names, spirit-power effect via damage csv on a cast ability if Surge is used
outcome: WORKS (stack): ability-2 cooldown in B/C/D equals the product/sum of both effects in both orders -> keep builds, add stacking to the model. REPLACES: only the last (or first) imbue shows -> order matters, 47 builds re-planned. REFUSED: second imbueown errors -> same.

title: Ability-only proc items vs bullet-delivered spirit damage (which damage type does it carry?)
heroes: Gigawatt/Seven (Power Surge shock), Hornet/Vindicta (Flight bonus spirit damage), Mina/Vampirebat (Love Bites), Wraith (Full Auto spirit per bullet), Victor/Frank (Reanimation bullets)
items: Mystic Slow, Suppressor, Healbane, Escalating Exposure, Mystic Vulnerability (all m_vecProcDamageTypes = ABILITY only)
mechanism: abilities.vdata m_AutoIntrinsicModifiers/m_vecProcDamageTypes lists only CITADEL_DAMAGETYPE_ABILITY for these five (FACT); the hero text says the bullet-attached damage is spirit damage but the damage-type tag of that damage is not in the vdata (the damage csv does record dmg_type per hit).
why: 45 of 81 builds hold >=1 of these five items; 7 of them sit on heroes whose repeated damage is bullet-borne (seven, seven_gun, victor, victor_gun, wraith, mina, vindicta_sniper). If the bullet-borne spirit damage is typed BULLET these items never trigger there.
decision: Typed ABILITY: bullet-spirit heroes get a per-bullet proc rate (huge for Escalating Exposure stacking and Healbane). Typed BULLET: the items are dead weight in those 7 builds -> swap (cheapest first).
test: setup Gigawatt (verify cast 3 with statecheck first; fall back to Wraith Full Auto)
arms: bullets only | cast 3 then fire 12 | cast 3 + Escalating Exposure then fire 12
ops: hardreset; give upgrade_escalating_exposure; enemies 1 300 4; eresist gun 50 then eresist spirit 50 as separate arms; cast 3 0.6; fetch 350; fire 12; mark
readback: dmg_type of each damage row, which resist moved the damage, whether damage per bullet rises across the burst (stack growth)
outcome: dmg_type=Ability on the shock/bonus rows AND damage growing across the burst -> eligible. dmg_type=Bullet or no growth -> the five items do not trigger from bullet-borne spirit damage.

title: Do bullet-resist reducers stack (add / multiply / strongest-only)?
items: Bullet Resist Shredder, Weakening Headshot, Crippling Headshot, Hollow Point, Hunter's Aura, Rusted Barrel, Disarming Hex, Alchemical Fire, Crushing Fists
mechanism: Each item applies its own resist-reduction modifier (items.json effects subtype=resist/op=reduce; abilities.vdata per-item values). The combining rule (additive vs multiplicative vs max-wins per modifier family) is engine-side and not in the vdata.
why: Redundant reducers are paid for in 20 builds; the model currently combines them by an assumed rule.
decision: If max-wins or heavy diminishing: cut the weaker reducer in those builds (800-6400 souls each) and reinvest. If multiplicative: keep and credit the full combined value in the trade model.
cost: 1 hero, 5 arms, ~20 bullets per arm, uses existing eresist + damage csv.
test: setup Haze Haze
arms: none | BRS | Weakening Headshot | BRS + Weakening Headshot | BRS + Weakening Headshot + Hollow Point
per arm: hardreset; give items; enemies 1 300 4; eresist gun 50 (fixed base resist); fetch 350; accuracy 1.0; fire 20 (headshots forced where required, mark each arm)
readback: mean damage per bullet from damage csv; base bullet damage from the A0 arm
outcome: Ratio of damage per bullet vs the product/sum predicted from each item's own value separates ADD / MULTIPLY / MAX. MAX or sub-additive -> prune redundant reducers (gate flag); MULTIPLY -> keep.

title: "Next bullet" items on burst, pellet and beam weapons
heroes: Lash and Gigawatt (3-round bursts), Chrono (5), Yamato (5 pellets), Drifter (3), Atlas/Calico (9 pellets), Shiv (6), Synth (7), Werewolf (7), Bebop (continuous beam)
items: Headshot Booster, Mystic Shot, Headhunter, Haunting Shot, Restorative Shot (cap 1 bullet per shot), Express Shot (fires twice, uses extra ammo)
mechanism: abilities.vdata: m_flMaxBulletsToProcInShot=1, m_bCanProcMultipleTimesFromSameShot=false, m_bCanProcMultipleTimesOnOneTarget=false on the five items (FACT). Weapon blocks: m_iBullets (pellets) and m_iBurstShotCount (burst) per hero weapon (FACT). Bebop weapon text: "continuous beam with no bullet travel" (FACT, text).
why: 13 builds combine such items with a multi-pellet/burst/beam weapon (paradox 3 items on a 5-round burst, lash 3 on a 3-burst, bebop 2 on the beam, shiv_gun, silver, yamato_brawler, danny_gun).
decision: Cap=1 means a flat next-bullet bonus is worth ~1 pellet of 5-9 on shotgun heroes (resolved by reading, the arithmetic is MODELLED). Open: does a burst count as one shot or several, do two items share the same first bullet or consume successive bullets, and does the beam ever raise "headshot"? Decides whether these items are bought on those heroes at all.
test: setup Haze Haze (control) and Drifter or Lash (multi-pellet/burst)
give upgrade_headshot_booster upgrade_crackshot upgrade_express_shot; enemies 1 300 4; fetch 350; accuracy 1.0; fire 6; mark
arms: each item alone | all three together
readback: per-bullet damage rows in order (which bullet carries which bonus), count of bullets per shot, ammo drop per shot (Express Shot)
outcome: Bonus lands on exactly one bullet per shot and items consume successive shots -> order/rotation matters, shotgun value divided by pellets. All items on the same first bullet -> bursty, cooldowns synchronise. No proc on beam -> drop on Bebop.

title: Healing Tempo: do granted lifesteals and ability heals count as "applying healing"?
heroes: 21 builds hold Healing Tempo (dynamo, kelvin x2, haze, rem, solomon_support, victor x2, viscous, yamato x2, geist x2, apollo x2, celeste x2, baba_tank, abrams, ivy, nurse)
items: Healing Tempo (6400, T4); sources: Vampiric Burst, Infuser (grant lifesteal for a duration), Healing Rite/Extra Health (regen), Rescue Beam, Healing Nova, ability lifesteals (Lash Flog, Yamato Crimson Slash, Krill Scorn, Bebop Hyper Beam)
mechanism: Item text (FACT): "Applying healing to yourself or an ally grants the target ...; does not apply on innate regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals". Item cd 1.0 s. Whether a lifesteal that is granted by an active (Vampiric Burst, Infuser) is "passive" is not in data.
why: A 6.4k T4 slot in 21 builds; its value depends entirely on which heal events count.
decision: If active-granted lifesteal and ability lifesteal count: Healing Tempo is strong in lifesteal builds. If only discrete heals count: keep it only on heal-ability heroes, swap elsewhere.
test: setup Haze Haze: give upgrade_healbuff upgrade_surging_power; lowhp 60; enemies 1 300 4; fetch 350; cast i1 (Vampiric Burst); fire 6; mods
control: Healing Rite instead of Vampiric Burst
readback: mods list for the Tempo buff, healDiffObserved with/without the item
outcome: Tempo buff appears on Vampiric Burst heals -> counts. Appears only for Healing Rite -> discrete heals only.

title: Chance / build-up bullet items on multi-pellet weapons: per pellet or per shot?
heroes: Calico/Nano (9 pellets, 0.21 s cycle), Shiv (6), Atlas (9), Synth (7), Silver/Werewolf (7), Drifter (3)
items: Tesla Bullets, Armor Piercer, Slowing Bullets, Weighted Shots, Toxic Bullets, Silencer, Inhibitor, Lucky Shot
mechanism: Lucky Shot (upgrade_critshot) has m_bCanProcMultipleTimesFromSameShot=true (FACT); Slowing Bullets/Weighted Shots have m_bProcAppliesBuildup=true (FACT); Armor Piercer, Tesla and Silencer carry no per-shot cap field (absence is not proof). Pellet counts from weapon blocks (FACT).
why: calico_gun and shiv_gun hold 3-5 of these items on 6-9 pellet weapons; drifter holds three on 3 pellets.
decision: Per pellet: proc and build-up rates scale with pellet count, so these items are far stronger on shotguns and the model must multiply. Per shot: they are worth the same as on a 1-bullet hero.
cost: 1 hero with pellets (+Haze control), counts only.
test: give upgrade_chain_lightning (and separately upgrade_critshot); enemies 1 300 4; fetch 350; accuracy 1.0; fire 30
run on Haze (1 bullet) and Drifter (3 pellets)
outcome: Proc rows per shot divided by the control: ~3x on Drifter -> per pellet; ~1x -> per shot.

title: Which items are triggered by summons / turrets / clones (m_bCanProcByOtherObjects)?
heroes: Forge/McGinnis (Mini Turret), Magician/Sinclair (Spectral Assistant), Necro/Graves (Deadheads), Chessmaster/Solomon (pieces), Ratking, Bookworm/Paige
items: can be charged by other objects (flag true): Mystic Burst, Tankbuster, Mystic Reverb, Suppressor, Quicksilver, Mercurial Magnum, Lightning Scroll, Ballistic Enchantment, Siphon Bullets, Arcane Eater. No such flag on Mystic Slow, Mystic Vulnerability, Healbane, Escalating Exposure.
mechanism: abilities.vdata m_bCanProcByOtherObjects = true on exactly those ten item classes (FACT); absent elsewhere (default presumably false, engine default not verified).
why: 14 summoner builds. mcginnis_turret (turret build) holds Mystic Slow + Mystic Vulnerability + Healbane + Escalating Exposure: none flagged; graves, graves_ult, graves_tank hold Mystic Vulnerability + Escalating Exposure.
decision: If the flag decides: summon heroes should buy the flagged burst/charge items and skip the unflagged spirit-debuff items (or credit them only for the hero's own casts). Largest swap candidate: mcginnis_turret.
test: setup Forge (verify cast 1 works; otherwise Magician)
arms: turret only | turret + Mystic Vulnerability | turret + Suppressor
ops: give item; enemies 1 300 4; cast 1; fetch 350; wait 6; cast own damaging ability; mark
readback: damage csv attributed to turret rows; amplified damage on the follow-up cast (Vulnerability); enemy fire-rate / mods (Suppressor)
outcome: Turret damage triggers flagged items only -> flag is authoritative, apply it to all 14 builds. Triggers both -> flag means something else, drop it from the model.

title: Abilities flagged PROJECTILE_FIRED_AS_BULLET: do they act as bullets for items and resist?
heroes: Nurse Leech Therapy, Viper Screwjab Dagger and Petrifying Bola, Werewolf Slam Fire and Entangling Bola, Bookworm Bookwyrm, Chrono Pulse Grenade, Hornet Stake, Kelvin Frost Grenade, Necro Jar of Dead, Ratking Scrap Grenade, Tengu Entangling Thorns
items: Burst Fire-type on-hit self buffs (Escalating Resilience, Spiritual Overflow), Armor Piercer, Ricochet, bullet-resist items on the target
mechanism: behaviours list contains PROJECTILE_FIRED_AS_BULLET for these 12 abilities and for the items Mystical Piano and Alchemical Fire (FACT). What that implies for item procs and for the resist applied is engine-side.
why: If these abilities count as bullet hits they can trigger bullet-hit items and may be reduced by bullet resist rather than spirit resist, changing how those heroes should itemise.
decision: Counts as bullet: bullet-hit procs/resist apply to the ability (re-class in the model, e.g. spirit vs gun item choice). Does not: no change.
test: setup Nurse Haze: give upgrade_reinforcing_casings; enemies 1 300 4; cast 1 aimed at the bot
arms: eresist gun 50 vs eresist spirit 50
readback: damage csv dmg_type and which resist scaled the damage; self mods for Escalating Resilience stack
outcome: Damage scales with the gun resist or Bullet type / self stack appears -> bullet; otherwise ability.

title: Spirit-resist reducers: do Spirit Strike / Snatch / Sap / Shredder / Mystic Vulnerability stack?
heroes: 12 builds hold >=3 (abrams, baba, baba_tank, bebop, bebop_bomb, calico, drifter_spirit, graves_tank, holliday_spirit, infernus, mirage, viscous_damage)
items: Spirit Strike, Spirit Snatch, Spirit Sap, Spirit Shredder, Mystic Vulnerability, Escalating Exposure (amp), Crippling Headshot
mechanism: Same family as N02 but on spirit resist; combining rule engine-side.
why: Several of these are bought together on melee/spirit builds.
decision: Prune redundant reducers or credit the product.
test: eresist spirit 50; give item sets; cast a damaging ability x3 per arm; compare damage

title: Duration Extender / Superior Duration: only flagged modifiers?
heroes: Drifter (Stalker's Mark), Infernus (Afterburn), Dynamo (Singularity), Seven (Storm Cloud), Sinclair (Rabbit Hex), Paige (Captivating Read), McGinnis (Heavy Barrage), Graves (Borrowed Decree), Silver, Pocket, Holliday, Mokrill, Ivy
mechanism: m_bDurationExtendible exists on 61 item modifiers and on a subset of hero modifiers (FACT: field values). In the effects data 18 Duration Extender imbues target abilities with no flagged modifier, and mcginnis_turret, mcginnis_ult, graves_ult, ivy hold Superior Duration with zero flagged ability. The extractor may under-detect flags that sit on debuff modifiers (caveat).
why: If the flag is the gate, those placements add nothing.
decision: Remove or re-target Duration Extender / Superior Duration in the listed builds; otherwise keep.
test: setup Drifter (cast slot 2 works) and Haze (Smoke Bomb flagged control)
arms: no imbue | Duration Extender imbued; cast 2; mods at 1 s steps until expiry
readback: modifier lifetime in seconds (mods + wait steps)
outcome: Unflagged ability lifetime unchanged while the flagged control lengthens -> flag is the gate (build edits needed). Both lengthen -> flag is not the gate.
tier: UNRESOLVED hypothesis (premise: game-data FACT with extractor caveat)

title: Hunter's Aura "doubled with one enemy hero nearby": the 1v1 case and stacking with other reducers
heroes: 11 builds (bebop, bebop_support, venator, yamato_brawler, apollo_melee, silver, sinclair, abrams_melee, drifter, calico_gun, shiv_gun)
mechanism: Item text (FACT): reduces nearby enemies' bullet resist and fire rate; doubled when only one enemy hero is nearby. Radius and the combining rule with other reducers are not tested.
why: Lane (1v1) value differs from fight value by 2x; the trade model assumes one.
decision: If doubling is real in lane and stacks with Weakening Headshot etc.: buy earlier on lane-heavy builds; else treat as fight-only.
test: give upgrade_bullet_armor_reduction_aura; eresist gun 50; enemies 1 300 4 vs enemies 3 300 4; fetch 350; fire 20
outcome: Damage per bullet with 1 vs 3 enemies differs by the doubled value.

title: Damage-over-time ticks and "spirit damage dealt" stacking (Escalating Exposure)
heroes: Inferno (Afterburn), Viper (Lethal Venom), Hornet (Crow bleed), Shiv, Astro (burn), Priest (burning), Ghost (toxic mess)
items: Escalating Exposure (38 builds), Mystic Vulnerability, Healbane, Mystic Slow
mechanism: Escalating Exposure proc types = ABILITY only (FACT). Affliction and Decay text explicitly "do not apply item procs" (documented); other DoTs carry no such text.
why: 38 builds hold Escalating Exposure; DoT heroes either saturate it per tick or never trigger it.
decision: Per tick: DoT heroes should prefer it; otherwise skip on them.
test: give upgrade_escalating_exposure; enemies 1 300 4; cast DoT ability; wait 4; cast a direct spirit ability; mark
control: no DoT first
outcome: Direct cast damage higher after a DoT than control -> ticks count.

title: Cast-triggered stacking (Spellslinger, Radiant Regeneration): which casts count?
heroes: 11 builds hold Spellslinger (bebop, haze_assassin, victor_gun, violet, wraith, geist, celeste_carry, warden, holliday, calico_gun, ivy_carry)
items: Spellslinger (6 stacks max, 18 s buff duration), Radiant Regeneration, Arcane Surge
mechanism: behaviour flag DO_NOT_ALLOW_SPAM_PROC (FACT) marks six abilities: Deadpack Jettison Fuel, Familiar Tag Along and Lil Helpers, Frank Aura of Suffering, Mirage Djinn's Mark, Nurse Healing Needles. Item text: "whenever you cast an ability or item". Which items read that flag is not in data.
why: Fast-cast kits (Wraith Card Trick 0.6 s, Frank, Mirage, Nurse) either fill Spellslinger instantly or are excluded.
decision: Excluded: Spellslinger is weak for those heroes (swap). Counted: strong enough to justify cheap actives bought only to stack it.
test: setup Nurse Haze: give upgrade_enchanted_holsters; enemies 1 300 4
arms: cast 3 x6 (flagged) | cast 1 x6 (unflagged) | item active x3 (Healing Rite)
mods after each cast
outcome: Stack count increments per arm identify which cast types count.

title: Mercurial Magnum / Quicksilver Reload: charge-up by time only, or also by damage?
heroes: 17 builds (dynamo_damage, greytalon_gun, haze, victor_gun, violet, wraith, mina, vindicta, mcginnis, celeste_carry, warden, vyper x2, holliday, graves, mokrill, nurse)
mechanism: Both items list m_vecProcDamageTypes = ABILITY, BULLET, MELEE and m_bCanProcByOtherObjects=true (FACT), which suggests damage dealt feeds the item as well as the timer; text says "charges up over time". Interaction between the two is not in data.
why: The reload-on-use value (and the ammo model) assumes a fixed time charge.
decision: Damage-accelerated: effective availability is shorter in fights; raise the value. Time only: unchanged.
test: setup Haze Haze: give upgrade_ethereal_bullets; imbueown upgrade_ethereal_bullets Signature2; enemies 1 300 4
arms: wait 8 then cast 2 | fire 40 for 8 s then cast 2
readback: clip/ammo after the cast (SC logs), mods for the charge
outcome: Different ammo refill / charge state at equal elapsed time -> damage matters.

title: Damage-reshaping kits vs threshold-triggered barriers (Bloodletting, Royal Pestments)
heroes: Shiv (Bloodletting defers damage), Ratking (Royal Pestments caps single hits), Viscous cube, Warden
items: Weapon Shielding, Spirit Shielding, Spellbreaker, Plated Armor, Reactive Barrier
mechanism: Shielding items trigger on "significant damage in a small time frame" (text, FACT); Bloodletting converts immediate damage to a deferred tick (kit text, FACT); Royal Pestments caps per-hit damage. Whether deferred ticks or capped hits satisfy the threshold is not in data.
why: shiv holds Spirit Shielding + Spellbreaker + Plated Armor; 22 builds hold a threshold barrier.
decision: If Bloodletting prevents the trigger: the barrier items are redundant on Shiv (cut ~3.2k). If ticks count: fine.
cost: Shiv, uses existing `incoming gun|spirit dps` op.
test: setup Shiv: give upgrade_weapon_shielding; enemies 1 300 4
arms: incoming gun 250 for 4 s | cast 3 then incoming gun 250 for 4 s
readback: barrier modifier appears? barrier amount (mods), HP loss
outcome: Barrier absent after Bloodletting -> redundant pair.

title: Heal-reduction and slow stacking (Leech, Toxic, Inhibitor, Healbane, Crippling Headshot; Slowing/Weighted/Mystic Slow)
heroes: 8 builds hold >=3 heal reducers (infernus, haze, geist, apollo, baba, mirage, graves, shiv); mirage holds six
items: listed + Leech (reduces effect of enemy healing reduction)
mechanism: Each applies its own modifier; combination rule not in data.
why: If reducers do not stack, 2-4 of them are dead in those builds.
cost: needs enemy healing / movement readback: BLOCKED in the current runner (no enemy heal or movement op).
test: BLOCKED: needs an op to heal or move the enemy bot and read the result

title: Shadow Weave ambush: triggered by hero-granted invisibility?
items: Shadow Weave, Shadow Strike, Veil Walker
mechanism: Shadow Weave text: attacking or using an ability ends stealth and starts an ambush; Smoke Bomb text: attacking removes invisibility. Both use an invisibility modifier; whether the ambush trigger reads any invisibility is not in data.
why: Would give a free ambush window from a cooldown the hero already has.
decision: Low: one build holds the item.
test: give upgrade_cloaking_device_active; cast 2; fire 3; mods
